cohort: 400 postpartum women who had given birth between 6 and 24 weeks prior to data collection in Zahedan city, Iran.
finding: 32% of the participants showed PTSD symptoms, which was significantly correlated with mode of delivery, history of curettage, length of hospitalization, and type of pregnancy.
mod_finding: The prevalence of PTSD was significantly associated with the mode of delivery, and a history of curettage, episiotomy, and vacuum evacuation increased the incidence of PTSD.
